strings.warnNoPkgs: ⚠️ Besingakghoni ukufunda irhelo leensetjenziswa ezifakiweko. Cindezela u-“🩺 Hlola ibhuloho”, bese ukopisha ilogo bese uyithumela ukwenzela bona sikghone ukuhlola.
strings.logDiagDone: 🩺 Hlola bona sele kuphelile — kopa imigqa engenhla bese uyithumela kumthuthukisi
strings.wvNote: Qaphela: amamaki akhombisa ukufundwa kwaphela — wekhwalithi yevidiyo yokuhlolwa kwependulo yokugcina (e.g. Netflix HD).
strings.cfgFail: ✖ Kwehlulekile ukugcina amasethingi — hlola ilogo, bese ucindezela “🩺 Hlola ibhuloho”
strings.logCfgFail: ✖ Amasethingi akhenge agcinwe — hlola iimvumo ekuhlolweni kwebhuloho
strings.logSuMode: 🔐 I-UI ayisebenzi njenge-root — ukutlola kuzokusebenzisa i-su
strings.confirmBaseline: Zoke iinsetjenziswa ezifakiweko njenganje zizokuthathwa njenge "sisekelo", njeke ziinsetjenziswa ozifakileko kusukela nje zizokufihlwa ngokuzenzakalelako. Raga?
strings.logBaselineDone: ✔ Ukusetha kabutjha kwenziwe — umgca wewatjhi manje {a} ama-app. Nanyana ngiyiphi i-app etja izokufihlwa ngokuzenzakalelako kungakapheli imizuzwana eli-10.
strings.logAutoLogHead: 📜 Izenzakalo zakamuva zokufihla ngokuzenzakalelako ezirekhodwe kudivayisi:
strings.logAutoLogEmpty: (akukho ilogi okwanje — okufakiweko kuvela lapha nanyana kunini lokha i-app etja nayifihliweko)

strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Sula Google ngokuzeleko:

• Isula Play Store + Google Play amasevisi + idatha ye-Services Framework.
• ⛔ UZOKUPHUMA Google ama-akhawunti (kufanele uwafake godu). ingathintwa.
• Idivayisi iqalisa kabutjha ngokuzenzakalelako ngemva.

Uqiniseka?
strings.logGwipeHead: 💣 Ukusula okupheleleko Google kuthomile — ukusula isitolo + amasevisi, bese uqalisa kabutjha...
strings.logCrlUnknown: 🟡 Angeze sakwazi ukuhlola nje (akukho inthanethi begodu akukho silondolozi)
strings.logCrlOk: 🟢 Ibhokisi lekhiye lihlanzekile — akukho zitifiketi ezihoxisiweko
strings.logKeyboxNone: ✖ Akukho bhokisi lekhiye elisebenzako elitholakala kudivayisi
strings.hintAdd: Faka ibizo lephakheji ukufihla ubunikazi bedivayisi kiyo. Isibonelo: com.netflix.mediaclient
strings.hintLog: Yonke imiyalo ihlanganiswe ngesikhathi sokuphumula — idivayisi angeze yajama. Ukutlola kukhawulelwe kufayela elilodwa kwaphela: /data/adb/tricky_store/target.txt
strings.demo: Imodi yokubuka ngaphambilini — ayikho umrabhu efasiteleni leli (isampula yedatha yokutjengisa kwaphela)
strings.footerTop: FALCON TRICKY · umngani ka FALCON INTEGRITY FIX
strings.maintHint: Thepha nanyana ngiyiphi ibhathini ukutjengisa ihlathululo yayo epheleleko.
strings.mdKbSmart: • Ukuthatha ibhokisi lekhiye elihlakaniphileko: lihlola ibhokisi lekhiye lamanje ngokujamelana nohlu lokuhoxiswa kwe-Google (CRL) begodu lilinga imithombo eminengi bekube kulapho lithola ibhokisi lekhiye elisebenzako, ngokusekela okuzenzakalelayo nokuqalisa kabutjha kwemisebenzi ye-Google. Isebenza ngaso soke isikhathi begodu idinga i-inthanethi (1-3 imizuzu).
strings.mdKbNet: • Ibhokisi lekhiye elivela kunethiwekhi: lidawuniloda ibhokisi lekhiye elivela endaweni yokugcina esemthethweni (i-GitHub) bese ulilondoloza ku-/data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Itlhoga i-inthanethi begodu ithatha imizuzu eyi-1-3. Isetjenziswa lokha ukulandwa okuhlakaniphileko nakuhlulekako nofana lokha ibhokisi lekhiye nalitjhugululwa ngesandla.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: ihlola amamojula we-Remote Key Provisioning etholakalako, ihlola TEE inguqulo yesitifiketi sokuqinisekisa, begodu itjengisa ubujamo bethulusi le-KmInstallKeybox. Akutjhugululi litho — umbono wesimo sedivayisi.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine hlola (ukufundwa kwaphela): kutjengisa Widevine iinkomba zezinga (L1/L3) ezivela ku-dumpsys, ubukhona befayela le-DRM (IDM), kanye nezinto ezihlobene nesistimu. Akutjhugululi litho.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Ukulungisa imanuwali RKP: isebenzisa imanuwali ye-sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh. Ilungisa imiraro yokuqinisekisa lokha ukuphasa okuzenzakalelayo kuhluleka. Njalo ukugijima kuphrinta umugqa ocacileko wempumelelo/wokwehluleka.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Ukulungiswa okupheleleko RKP: kugijima i-sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh ngokuzeleko. Iphatha amacala abudisi begodu ithatha isikhathi eside. Umphumela ocacileko uvela ekugcineni.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Setha kabutjha i-GMS: isula idatha yamasevisi we-Play Store kanye ne-Google (GMS+GSF) bese iqalisa kabutjha idivayisi ngokuzenzakalelako. Ukuqinisekiswa okuqinileko kwaphela — akusoze kwathinta iinthombe zakho nofana amafayela.
strings.mdCertify: • Isitifiketi sokudlala: sihlola ubujamo bokuqinisekisa isitifiketi RKP sedivayisi begodu isetha kabutjha izakhiwo zokuqinisekisa nangabe kuyatlhogeka. Ayithinti idatha yomsebenzisi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER ukulungisa: kulungisa Google ihlelo leenkonzo (SOTER) iindaba ezihlobene nokuqinisekiswa kwedivayisi. Isetjenziselwa amanye amadivayisi athembele ku-SOTER esikhundleni se-Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Sebenzisa i-PIF: isebenzisa amandla we-sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh. Isebenzisa iminwe ekhethiweko (yendawo/ethuthukileko) begodu ivuselela amafayela we-pif.prop/pif.json. Umphumela ocacileko uvela kulogi.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF hlola: kutjengisa ubujamo benjini efakiweko, amafayela weminwe (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), kanye namalogi. Hlola kwaphela — ayitjhugululi litho.
strings.mdCanary: • Ukubuyekezwa kwe-Canary: kugijima i-sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ithola ukukhishwa kwamuva kwe-Canary Engine ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nezitifiketi eziqakathekileko RKP (Nhlolanja 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Ukuhlolwa kwenjini: kuhlola ubujamo be-TrickyStoreOSS (i-pid, amalogi), amafayela webhokisi lamakhiye (asebenzako vs umsebenzisi), i-fingerprint yedivayisi yangempela vs engakaqini, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP amakhi. Ukutjengiswa kokuhlola kwaphela.
strings.hintKbSlots: Imojuli ilawula iindawo ezimbili zamabhokisi weenkinobho: eyinhloko (eyingcwele, engakaze isulwe) neyesibili (eyisipele). Ithebhu le itjengisa bona ngisiphi isikhala esisebenzako, esitjhugulula ukukhetha, nofana sikhuthaze okusesigabeni sesibili ukuya kokuthoma ngesibawo esicacileko — ngama-backup kanye nelogi epheleleko.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Ukuhlolwa kobuqotho: kuhlola ukungeniswa kwekhi ye-TEE, ukufakwa kwelayibhrari ngaphakathi kwe-keystore2, ubujamo bokuhoxiswa (CRL), ukuvikelwa kohlu lokuvikelwa kanye nobujamo be-RKP. Ukufundwa kwaphela — akutjhugululi litho.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Ukufaka kabutjha okuphephileko:

• Irhelo lokuvikela lakhiwa kabutjha kiyo yoke i-app efakiweko.
• Isendlalelo sokuvumelana kwe-custom-ROM sisetjenziswa godu.
• Ibhokisi lekhiye elisebenzako liyasetjenziswa godu. iqaliwe kabutjha.

Akukho okususiweko begodu ibhokisi lekhiye eliyinhloko alithintwa.

Ragela phambili?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Izikhala zebhokisi lekhiye: zitjengisa ubujamo bezikhala eziphambili nezesibili begodu zitjhugulula ukukhetha hlangana nazo. I-primary (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) ihlala ivikelekile begodu ayisulwa. Ukukhuphula i-secondary ukuya e-primary kutlhoga ukuqinisekiswa okucacileko.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Khuphumela isikhala sesibili sibe yi-primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml iba yi-primary slot content.
• I-primary yamanje igcinwa njenge-backup ngaphambi kokubuyiselwa.
• Akukho okususwako — umsebenzi uyabuyiselwa emuva.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Sula isikhala sesibili:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml sizokususwa.
• Isikhala esiyinhloko asithintwa.

Ragela phambili?
strings.dgRkpTool: Ukuba khona kwethulusi lokulungisa isikhiya se-ZTE
strings.dgE3: Injini ithoma ngokuzenzakalelako lokha nayiqalisako kwaphela — ungayithomi ngesandla
strings.dgE3a: (ukuthoma ngesandla kuvaliwe unomphela: ukuyithoma kabili kufaka i-keystore2 kabili bese kuvala idivayisi)
strings.dgE3b: Nangabe ayisebenzi: qalisa kabutjha idivayisi — begodu ungayiqali ngesandla.
strings.dgE6: imodyuli ye-tricky_store ezijameleko (akukafaneli ifakwe — iyasuswa ngokuzenzakalelako)
strings.dgE61: woke amamojula afakiweko (ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi akukho okususwe ngaphandle kwesizathu)
strings.dgActNeStock: esebenzako != ibhokisi lekhi yemodyuli ehlanganisiweko (usebenzisa ibhokisi lekhiye elikhethekileko)
strings.logNoStart: ⛔ Injini ayiqalwa ukusuka kule-UI (ukuvikelwa kokujova kabili).
strings.logDemo: ⚠️ Imodi yokubuka ngaphambilini: ayikho ibhuloho yomyalo kulelifasitela — idatha yesampula.
strings.logMustLocked: ⛔ Ukungena okufunekako — Ukuthembeka kokudlala kuya ngokuthi
strings.logDemoAction: ℹ️ Imodi yokubuka ngaphambilini — akukho miyalo yamambala eyenziwako
strings.confirmEssential: Irhelo elifihliweko lizokwehliswa libe zizinto ezintathu eziqakathekileko, begodu woke amanye ama-app azokubonakala. Raga?
strings.hintMaint: FALCON INTEGRITY FIX amathulusi — yoke imisebenzi ivikelwe isikhathi, begodu ithuthuko ivela bukhoma kulogi.
strings.confirmKbSmart:
Ukuthathwa kwebhokisi lekhiye elihlakaniphileko (okutjha ku v3.17):

• Ihlola ibhokisi lekhiye lamanje ngokujamelana nohlu lokurhoxisa Google (CRL).
• Ilinga imithombo eminengi bekube kulapho kutholakala ibhokisi lekhiye elihlanzekileko.
• Isipele esizenzakalelayo + siqalisa kabutjha #000## imisebenzi.

⚠️ Itlhoga i-inthanethi (1-3 imiz). Raga?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Thatha ibhokisi lekhiye ku-inthanethi:

• Udawuniloda ibhokisi lekhiye elisemthethweni bese uyaliqinisekisa.
• Ifakwe unomphela (azange ibuyiselwe emuva ekuqaliseni). Raga?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Ukunikela kabutjha RKP amakhi:

• Akukho datha nofana amafayela webhokisi lamakhiye asusiweko.
• Qalisa kabutjha ifowuni ngemva kwalokho.

Ragela phambili?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Ukulungiswa okupheleleko:

• Ukulungiswa kabutjha RKP + kuqalisa kabutjha Google amasevisi.
• Idivayisi iqalisa kabutjha ngokuzenzakalelako (akukho okususwako).

Uragela phambili?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Qalisa kabutjha Google amasevisi:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — qalisa kabutjha kwaphela.
• Akukho okususwako begodu ANGEKHO ukuphuma.
• Idivayisi iqalisa kabutjha ngokuzenzakalelako.
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Ukugandelela ukuhlinzeka kabutjha (Umlingo Obomvu):

• Kwamadivayisi angatjheji ibhokisi lekhiye elivuzako.
• Isebenza ngitjho nanyana iinkinobho ziphilile.
• Akukho datha esusiweko.

Ragela phambili?
strings.confirmCertify:
Ukugandelela Play Store isitifiketi:

• Sula isilondolozi seSitolo kwaphela — i-akhawunti yakho ayithintwa.
• Qalisa kabutjha, bese uvula iSitolo.

Ragela phambili?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• Iqalisa kabutjha vendor.soter isevisi.
• Isula SOTER idatha yeseva kwaphela.

Ragela phambili?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Faka i-fingerprint (PIF):

• Iguqula i-custom.pif.prop bese iyifaka endleleni yenjini.
• Ifuna ukuqalisa kabutjha ngemva kwalokho.

Ragela phambili?
strings.confirmCanary:
Vuselela i-Canary fingerprint:

• Udawuniloda i-Canary fingerprint yakamuva evela ku-Google.
• Ivumelanisa i-patch yezokuphepha + iqalisa kabutjha Google imisebenzi (akukho ukusula).

⚠️ Itlhoga i-inthanethi (1-3 imizuzu). Raga?
